name: Multi-level Semantic Consistency Loss
definition: A loss function introduced to assist with more informative representation learning by integrating pixel-level loss and semantic feature matching loss to constrain global similarity between predicted images and ground truth.
summary: Multi-level Semantic Consistency Loss enforces structural and semantic similarity in volume rendering by comparing multi-scale feature maps, distinguishing itself by constraining both high-level semantics and low-level structure unlike global semantic-only approaches.
